audits.methods_used:
**Phase 1 (Inventory)**: Manual parse of 7 daily + 2 weekly reports; extraction of 131 calls into JSONL structure with fields: ticker, horizon, raw_score, score_components[], dominant_signal_class, tools_cited[], claimed_win_rate, structure, entry_date. Legacy-format flag applied to first 2 daily reports (23 calls) lacking formal audit trail.

**Phase 2 (Outcome Resolution)**: Path-aware WIN/LOSS/INCONCLUSIVE grading using horizon-matched windows (swing 3D/10D, LEAP 30D/90D, weekly 5D/10D). Ground-truth sources: W18 §0 hit-table (9 resolved), W19 §0 hit-table (20 resolved), mcp__uw-historical__signal_backtest on May 5–6 entries with 5-trading-day forward look (31 resolved). De-duplication yields ~52 unique resolved calls. Win threshold: ≥+1R in thesis direction within window, no −1R drawdown prior (path-aware). Brier calculated as (1/N) × Σ(claimed − outcome)² on N=27 calls with claimed_win_rate and outcome ∈ {0, 1}.

**Phase 3 (Calibration)**: Per-signal-class claimed vs realised win-rate comparison (n=2 to n=10 per class, small-N noise acknowledged). Per-tier realised win-rate bucketing (HIGH/MED/LOW). Tier monotonicity check. Quintile scatter of raw_score vs outcome. Brier score calculation with residual decomposition.

**Phase 4 (Tool Attribution)**: Marginal-contribution math per tool defined as: (win-rate of resolved calls citing the tool) − (win-rate of resolved calls in same signal class NOT citing the tool). Tools grouped by marginal contribution: LOAD-BEARING (≥+10pp), SUPPORTIVE (+3 to +10pp), CONFOUNDED (outcome leakage check), NO-INFO (±2pp), INSUFFICIENT_N (<5 citations). Citation frequency table (n=2 to n=28 per tool across 131 calls).

**Phase 5 (Schema Critique)**: Component-weight audit by Phase 4 marginal-contribution; current vs proposed rubric table. Tier-cut rebin by Phase 3 per-quintile realised win-rate. Holdout stress-test: in-sample (2026-04-30 to 2026-05-06, N~32 resolved) vs holdout (2026-05-07 to 2026-05-08, N~20 resolved). Holdout realised WR and Brier predicted under proposed schema. Verdict: ACCEPT_WITH_CAVEAT — mechanical changes immediate, tier-cut rebin deferred.

**Phase 6 (Decision-Process Audit)**: Compliance checks on signal-confluence-quant (mechanical sum check: 85.2% PASS; source_agent+tool naming: 85.6% both fields populated; pre_risk_size vs sizing-map: 65.7% compliant) and risk-monitor (per-gate firing rate: regime 91.8%, VRP 37.5%, panic 65.9%, correlation 82.0%, sector 75.0%). Missed-gate ledger with operational-drift detection. Overall compliance ~75% across all gates.

**Phase 7 (Recommendations)**: Prioritisation into P0 (mechanical, apply immediately), P1 (clear improvements, defer until N≥100), P2 (polish, low confidence). Each recommendation grounded in specific phase + data point + justification. Summary table tracking applied vs deferred status.
self_admitted_limits: DATASET-SIZE-RELAXED: N=7 daily + 2 weekly reports below default thresholds (10 daily OR 3 weekly). ~52 of 131 calls resolvable to WIN/LOSS; ~79 calls marked INCONCLUSIVE (window unrealised at audit date 2026-05-09). Per-signal-class N=2 to N=10 in resolved population — all numerical findings are noise-dominated (Brier, win-rates per quintile). Structural findings (tier monotonicity, gate compliance, tool tiers) higher confidence than numerical.

Phase 2 outcome windows: W18 and W19 retros graded on Mon-vs-Fri end-points (end-of-week snapshot), NOT path-aware. Small dataset means forward-window resolution biased to early-week entries; 2026-05-07 and 2026-05-08 entries have no meaningful forward window at audit time.

Format coverage: first 2 daily reports (2026-04-30, 2026-05-01) lack formal score_components audit-trail. 23 calls marked legacy_format, excluded from Phase 6 denominators. Phase 4 tool attribution keeps these rows (tools_cited recoverable from body text) but Phase 6 gate-compliance cannot audit their claimed_win_rate.

Phase 5 holdout is structurally limited: 2026-05-08 calls are entirely INCONCLUSIVE (entry date = audit date − 1). In-sample vs holdout fold is 6 reports vs 3 reports (~2:1 imbalance). Holdout Brier and WR predictions should not be read as generalization proof.

Tool marginal-contribution math in Phase 4 uses within-signal-class baselines (when tool cited only within one class). Tools cited across multiple signal classes (oi_trend, conviction_matrix) have colinearity issues not fully decomposed; marginal contributions are approximate.

Phase 6 gate-compliance denominators exclude legacy-format calls (n=23). VRP-gate "missed" count includes cases where the gate output says 'no-op (VRP FAIR)' but the agent's internal reasoning is not surfaced — interpretation of silence as non-compliance may overstate drift.

Conviction-matrix LEAP gate analysis (Phase 4, R-10): the claim that the tool 'never crosses' is based on audit-trail readouts, not on MCP tool execution logs. Possible confound: tool may fire internally but agent prompt filters the output.

Rubric monotonicity holds in the resolved sample, but realised N=27 with outlier-driven Brier (4 LOSS rows account for ~2.89 of 2.95 total residual). Tier gaps (3–9pp between HIGH/MED/LOW) are small; reweight proposals in Phase 5 are structural, not statistical.

No causality inference: the audit assigns tool marginal contributions post-hoc. If an agent cites Tool X and wins, we infer Tool X added signal — but correlated confounds (e.g., Tool X cited preferentially on obvious setups) are not deconfounded.

P1 and P2 recommendations are deferred pending larger N. Phase 5 holdout gap (15pp between HIGH and MED predicted realised WR) is directional — datapoint count is too low to be the statistical basis for tier-cut rebin.

audits.audit: Calibration audit for 2026-04-30 through 2026-05-15. Dataset: 15 reports (12 daily + 3 weekly) = 205 trade rows extracted; 132 with price coverage; 52 fully resolved on 3D not skipped. Regime: TRANSITIONAL/UPTREND throughout — all findings regime-conditioned, not generalizable to risk-off. Phase 1: parsed legacy/rubric-drift; Phase 2: resolved outcomes on path-aware 3D/10D/30D windows using regime-specific R (2.0%-4.0% for major names, 1.0% for indices, vol_realization for earnings); Phase 3: claimed vs realised win-rate per signal class; Phase 4: MCP tool marginal contribution via WR_with − WR_without; Phase 5: re-bin tiers and reweight components against Phase 4 deltas; Phase 6: compliance audit of rubric application in live reports (catch missed gates); Phase 7: propose-only patch intentions tied to phase + data point.

headline_findings: Finding A — GEX strike grid never covers spot (fatal): Before fix: options-structure gex with default --dte-max 45 returned a 50-strike grid that on every single session for both tickers topped out below spot. SPY: 0/31 sessions where grid covered spot, grid max 490–556 while spot 639–747 (~70–200 pts below). QQQ: 0/31 sessions, grid max 415–520 while spot 566–720 (~150–245 pts below). Grid was hard-capped at 50 strikes and bottom-truncated; only deep-ITM-put / far-OTM strikes surfaced, never ATM/OTM-call strikes where gamma walls and flip actually live. Root cause (superseded by addendum): not display truncation but trade-level duplication in bot-eod-report-*.parquet — each contract's EOD open_interest repeated on every print; GEX summed gamma·OI·100·spot once per trade, inflating total_gex by ~3 orders of magnitude, pushing cumulative-GEX crossing arbitrarily, and combined with perStrike[:50] head-truncation made grid show only deep-OTM strikes.

headline_findings: FINDING 1 (P0.1): The rubric is anti-calibrated with Brier 0.34 — well below the 0.10 'professionally calibrated' threshold. Conviction tier does not rank outcomes: HIGH 53.7% (n=41) / MEDIUM 46.0% (n=124) / LOW 55.8% (n=86), inverted (MEDIUM < LOW). Critically, HIGH-tier directional trades have NEGATIVE expectancy of −1.52% per trade with 0.06 payoff ratio (win small, lose big). The problem is quote inflation: dark_pool_accumulation claimed 82.8%, realised 51.2% (−31.6pp, n=43); vol_surface claimed 80.2%, realised 47.1% (−33.2pp, n=34); gamma_pin claimed 63.9%, realised 30.0% (−33.9pp, n=20). The truth-set backtest tool returns N=0 for dark-pool rates — the 80%+ figures have no spine. [Phase 3 §1-2, Phase 5 §D, Brier 0.34 formula]

FINDING 2 (P0.2): The HIGH-tier LOAD-BEARING-tool gate (3-of-5) admits two anti-predictive tools: cumulative-premium-flow (NO-INFO, +2.0pp, n=76, the single most-cited tool yet carries zero discriminating power) and institutional-accumulation (NEGATIVE, −12.6pp, n=5). These block-strata truth-set rates from the gate set. Proposed gate fix: replace with sweep-persistence (+19.5 / +31.9pp, n=28 / 11) and oi-trend (+12.2pp, n=45). [Phase 4 §Tool tier list, Phase 5 §B]

FINDING 3 (P0.3): The cumulative-premium-flow rubric line awards +3 points to the single most-cited tool (n=76) that is NO-INFO (+2.0pp MC). Budget-neutral reallocation: demote to +1, introduce +2 multi-day sweep-persistence line (the actual load-bearing tool). [Phase 4 §Desk commentary, Phase 5 §A]

FINDING 4 (Honest tools): dealer_positioning class achieves 84% claimed / 80% realised WR (−4.4pp, n=20) — the rubric's only honest high-claimed class and the highest realised win-rate in the book. bearish_flow is also honest (42.5% claimed / 44.0% realised, +1.5pp, n=25) — the desk correctly distrusts its own shorts. Both should be retained uncapped. [Phase 3 §Verdict (a-b)]

FINDING 5 (Overall book edge): Hit-rate is 47.3% (328 decided) or 51.1% directional (188 signed, coin-flip level), but payoff is 1.47 on directional trades: mean WIN +2.86% vs mean LOSS −1.95% → expectancy ≈ +0.50%/trade. The book makes money on asymmetry, not on being right more than half the time. Entire positive expectancy is concentrated in the MEDIUM tier (MEDIUM +1.93%, HIGH −1.52%, LOW +0.19%). PHASE 2 OUTCOME RESOLUTION: Outcomes resolved close-to-close, path-aware (intraday range unavailable from yfinance and uw historical trend). R = 0.5 × ATR_proxy (mean |closeₜ − closeₜ₋₁| over 14 bars preceding entry). Windows per horizon: 0DTE +1D abs-move, swing 3D/10D, weekly 5D/10D, LEAP 30D/90D. Win = ≥+1R move in thesis direction without −1R drawdown first. Multi-window horizons require both windows to agree or longer window decisive; disagreement = INCONCLUSIVE. Incomplete windows (not all N trading days available) = window_open, never truncated. Truth-set signal-class rates from uw historical signal-backtest (current snapshot, no --date flag). C3 expectancy table (directional signed, n=188): E[trade] = WR × mean(WIN) + (1−WR) × mean(LOSS); payoff R = mean(WIN) / |mean(LOSS)|. headline_findings: FINDING 1: Long book is negative-edge beta. BOOK-long 58.0% vs SPY-long 80.2% base = -22.2pp excess (n=176). Every long signal class trails its SPY benchmark: dark-pool -21pp, bullish -20pp, even dealer_positioning -7pp. Shorts +19.7pp excess (n=63). SHORT SELECTION is the book's only directional alpha. [Source: Phase 2, C21 benchmark-excess; Phase 3 per-class table n≥8]

FINDING 2: Overconfidence is localized to ≥0.80 quote tail. Reliability diagram shows: ≥0.90 bucket (n=38) realises 53% (quoted 96%), 0.80-0.90 (n=21) realises 62% (quoted 82%). Brier 0.316 and log-loss 1.030 reside entirely in high-confidence tail. The <0.70 bucket is well-calibrated or slightly under-confident (shorts 0.00-0.40: realises 52%, quoted 25% — desk under-quotes shorts). [Source: Phase 3 C25 reliability diagram; log-loss calculation]

FINDING 3: MED<LOW tier inversion is a direction defect, not a cut defect. LOW (51.5%, n=97) beats MED (49.0%, n=147) under every cut tested (≥10, ≥9, ≥8) because alpha-generating shorts score LOW while beta longs score MEDIUM. The rubric awards points for long-side flow that is benchmark-negative and under-scores short selection that is benchmark-positive. Score ≥9 cohort realises 77-79% (n=31) vs MED 50.6% — discrimination exists at top but tier ladder inversely correlated with edge. Re-binning cuts cannot fix a score inversely correlated with edge. [Source: Phase 5 §B per-integer WR table; Phase 3d directional-excess analysis]

FINDING 4: Zero tools survive Benjamini-Hochberg multiple-hypothesis correction. Running ~25 simultaneous tool-tier tests across legacy-prose reconstructed citations at FDR 0.10 — no tool clears the gate. The entire 2026-05-29 P0 tool-surgery (add oi-trend, swap gate tools, demote term-skew) was built on uncorrected noise. Only dark-pool block-stratified (+14pp) and options-structure dex (+14pp) are durable across close-only (05-29) and path-aware (05-30) methods — the desk's two real evidence tools. Everything else moved 15-30pp with resolution method. [Source: Phase 4 tool tier table, C23 BH flags; Phase 4 & meta-audit desk commentary]

FINDING 5: Tool tiers are method-unstable. term-skew flipped -13.4pp → +7.9pp (sign reversal); oi-trend +12.2 → +0.4; signal-confluence +17.2 → -1.0; hot-chains sweep-persistence +19.5 → -2.6. Sign flips are vol-proxy artifacts (vol_long 53%-84% range expansion). The 05-29 'demote term-skew' and 'add oi-trend/signal-confluence to gate' recommendations are retracted — they were close-only artifacts. [Source: Phase 4 table; Phase 4 & COMPARISON desk commentary]

C24 gate-effectiveness lane shows event_risk downgraded names lost (effective), but fundamentals VETO'd names WON 2/3 times (67% FP-rate, n=3).
